title: Apostle video spec
description: What the model writes in the compile pipeline (scripts/compile-brief.cjs, prompts/compile/spec.v1.md) and what a human edits by hand. scripts/lib/compile-spec.cjs turns it into a beats doc (beats-schema.json) and a moments doc (applyMoments). Structural checks live here; the semantic ones (cues found in the VO, glyph names, VO verbatim, per-layout payloads) are in scripts/lib/validate-spec.cjs. The CommBank specs in briefs/commbank-yello/specs/ are the measured-timing form of the same format.

name.description: Master comp base name; the build appends _vNNN.

slug.description: File name for specs/, beats/ and moments/.

briefDir.description: Repo-relative briefs/<client> folder outputs are written to.

script.description: Repo-relative path of the source script, for provenance.

brandKit.description: Repo-relative brands/<kit>.json. The CLI --brand flag overrides it.

easeProfile.description: A key of EASE_PROFILES in apostle.jsx (corporate-smooth, snappy, playful, curvaceous).

resolution.description: Only 1920x1080 is supported: moment layouts are drawn in fixed 1080p geometry.

mode.description: wpm: estimate from word counts (no VO yet). words: align to a vo-align.py words.json. measured: beats[].start and spec.end in seconds (the CommBank form). Default: measured when spec.end is set, else wpm.

words.description: words mode: repo-relative path to words.json

end.description: measured mode: second at which speech ends

tail.description: Extra hold on the final beat (endcard).

textReveal.description: false turns the word-by-word reveal off.

screens.description: Folder of app screenshots. build imports the ones the spec uses into the project folder 'screens'.

titleCard.description: Opening card the VO never says. Runs before the first spoken word and pushes the VO back by dur.

id.description: Optional fixed beatId. Default: slug of the first words of vo (stable across rebuilds).

vo.description: Verbatim VO for this beat. Every word of the video's VO belongs to exactly one beat, in order.

start.description: measured mode only: absolute VO second where this beat's first word is spoken

holdSec.description: wpm mode only: duration of a beat with no vo

preset.description: Omit to infer: listBuild when any moment uses a list layout.

cue.description: wpm/words modes: verbatim opening words of the vo where this moment starts. Not needed on a beat's first moment.

at.description: measured mode: absolute VO second where this moment starts

shot.description: screen layout: footage name (file name without extension) in the project's 'screens' folder

glyph.description: A key of MOM_GLYPHS in apostle.jsx.

picto.description: Name of a footage item in the project's 'pictograms' folder; falls back to glyph.

why.description: The model's reason for this moment. Stripped before build.
